contractors.notes: World's largest FPSO lessor. Kaminho는 Saipem EPC로 SBM과 무관. One Guyana sold to ExxonMobil Q1 2026. [2026-10-08] backlog 38.9→35.6 정정·갱신: FY2025 실제 directional backlog는 $31.1B(기존 38.9는 오기), H1 2026 pro-forma $35.6B(+14%). 2026 가이던스 상향: directional revenue ~$7.6B, EBITDA ~$1.9B. [2026-10-13] 보유 13→12: Liza Unity는 2023-11 ExxonMobil 매입(SBM 운영만).
contractors.notes_en: World's largest FPSO lessor. Fast4Ward standardised hull. 13 units on L&O; [Corrected 2026-10-13] No L&O (lease) newbuilds under construction — Jaguar is sold to ExxonMobil and then operated, GranMorgu is a TotalEnergies turnkey, SEAP I/II (P-81, P-87) are Petrobras-owned with SBM build + O&M. [2026-10-08] Backlog corrected/updated 38.9→35.6: actual FY2025 directional backlog was $31.1B (previous 38.9 was an error); H1 2026 pro-forma $35.6B (+14%). 2026 guidance raised: directional revenue ~$7.6B, EBITDA ~$1.9B. [2026-10-13] Owned 13→12: Liza Unity was bought by ExxonMobil in Nov 2023 (SBM operates only).

contractors.notes: Malaysia's leading FPSO lessor; high backlog growth trajectory. [2026-10-08] backlog 20.5→19.3: Q2 FY2027(2026-07-31) 가동 FPSO 선단 contracted revenue backlog ~$19.3B(2등급 출처). RHB Research는 order book $18.9B 제시. [2026-10-10] 위 backlog 수치는 7/31 기준이라 미조정 — 이후 JAK 계약 변경(+~$0.6B, 2026-10-02)과 Agogo 채권 리파이낸싱($1.458B, 10/7 발행가격 결정)이 발표됨. 다음 분기 결산에서 반영. [2026-10-13] 보유 대수 9→8 정정: Yinson Production 공식 선단(자산 11개) = FPSO 8척(PTSC Lam Son, John Agyekum Kufuor, Helang, Abigail-Joseph, Anna Nery, Maria Quitéria, Atlanta, Agogo) + FSO 3척(Bien Dong 01 가동, Lac Da Vang·Block B 건조 중). 기존 9는 FSO Bien Dong 01까지 센 것으로 보임 — 이 대시보드는 FPSO/FLNG 기준. 공식 페이지 backlog는 $18.9B(2026-04-30, 옵션 포함, 지분 기준).
contractors.source_en: Baird Maritime — Yinson Q2 FY2027 (Sep 2026): operating FPSO fleet contracted revenue backlog
contractors.notes_en: Malaysia's leading FPSO lessor; high backlog growth trajectory. [2026-10-08] Backlog 20.5→19.3: Q2 FY2027 (2026-07-31) operating FPSO fleet contracted revenue backlog ~$19.3B (tier-2 source). RHB Research cites an order book of $18.9B. [2026-10-10] The backlog above is as of 7/31 and not yet adjusted — since then the JAK contract amendment (+~$0.6B, 2026-10-02) and the Agogo bond refinancing ($1.458B, priced 10/7) were announced. [2026-10-13] Owned units corrected 9→8: Yinson Production's official fleet (11 assets) = 8 FPSOs (PTSC Lam Son, John Agyekum Kufuor, Helang, Abigail-Joseph, Anna Nery, Maria Quitéria, Atlanta, Agogo) + 3 FSOs (Bien Dong 01 operating; Lac Da Vang and Block B under construction). Built by Seatrium BrasFELS. [2026-10-13 audit] Confirmed 150k bpd, gas 6 MMm³/d (212), 1.6 MMbbl storage, production start Dec 2022. 2,010m WD unsourced → null.

orderbook.name: Kaminho FPSO
orderbook.notes: [정정 2026-10-08] VLCC(Alsace) 개조 FPSO, Saipem EPC — 기존 "SBM Fast4Ward 선형"은 오류. 70k bbl/d, 수반가스 전량 재주입. 앙골라 Kwanza 분지 Cameia·Golfinho, TotalEnergies 40%(op)·PETRONAS 40%·Sonangol 20%.
